text: {"verdict": "ABSTAIN", "rule": null, "rationale": "Every action (change_plate, measure_cp) is allowed for campaign_class 'full', so I8 is satisfied. No deposition, anneal, durability test or acid use appears, so I2, I3, I3b, I5 and I6b do not apply, and ALLOW does not apply to an internal_agent. However, the plan repeats measure_cp about 45 times without giving a duration per measurement, so total instrument time (I6, I7) cannot be checked. It also gives no predicted steady-state potential (I1) and no mapping of comp_vec positions to elements (I4). These values cannot be invented, so safety cannot be determined."}
